versions.changelog:
insta-post 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Publish Instagram posts via browser automation using the OpenClaw browser tool.
- Supports image uploads (JPG only), caption entry, collaborator tagging, and post sharing.
- Includes command-line script for quick uploads.
- Step-by-step browser automation method for creating and publishing posts.
- Troubleshooting guidance for common upload and interaction issues.
